content: Bininj Birrirurrkdundulubom Manrurrkkuyeng Duninjh Kore Kunred Babel.
Kerrngehkenhni bininj rowk nawu birrihni kurorre wanjh birriwokkudjini, kundjenkudji birridjarrkwokdi.
Kaluk bu bininj birrihrey koyek wanjh birribolkngalkeng kabbal kore kubolkwarlah kabolkngeyyo Shinar, wanjh kumekbe birriyerrkang.

Wanjh bedda birrimarneyimerrinj, “Kab karrimarnbu manwern brick, karrikinje kukunak ba karayekmen.” Wanjh birribawong kunwardde bu birrirurrkmarnbuni, dja birrimarnbuni manwern brick, dja tar birribarungi bu birribelbmi.

Wanjh birrimarneyimerrinj, “Kab karrimarnbu kadberre kubolkkimuk, dja karrirurrknamen warridj manrurrkkuyeng duninjh manbu kadjalewi kaddum kungol, ba karringeykukenworren, dja marndi kandikukyarlarrke karribebbehre kubolkbubuyika rowk kore kurorre.”
Wanjh Yawey kumkoluy kanan kubolkkimuk dja manrurrkkuyeng manbu bininj birrimarnbuni.

Dja nungka Yawey yimeng, “Bedda bininj wanjh birridjalkudji dja birriwokkudjiwi. Kuhni wanjh yiman birridjaldedjdjingmey, dja kunwern mak kaluk kabirrikurduyime warridj, wanjh bonj yehyeng nawu bedda kabirrikarremarnbun, yimankek kabirrikurduyime, wanjh minj kabirribarabun.
Kab ngarrkolung ngarrbendjenborledke ba bu kabirribebbehwokwakwarren dja kabirrimayahmerren.”
Wanjh Yawey benyarlarrkeng, benbebbehmunkeweng kumekbebeh birribebbehwam kubolkbubuyika rowk kore kurorre, wanjh birribawong bu kubolkkimuk birrirurrkmarnbuni.

Dja kumekbe wanjh Yawey benbebbehdjenborledkeng dja birribebbehmayahmeng. Wanjh kunmekbekenh kunu kabolkngeyyo Babel. Kunekke kunngey kayime “Birrimayahmeng”. Dja mak kumekbebeh Yawey benyarlarrkeng benbebbehmunkeweng birribebbehwam kubolkbubuyika rowk kore kurorre.
Nawu Shem Benkebmawahmeng Kaluk Abram Dorrengh.
Kuhni wanjh kabenyolyolme nawu Shem benbornang dja benkebmawahmeng. Kaluk yerrekah mandjewk bokenh bu kundjurrh yakminj, kaluk bu Shem nuyeni mandjewk wanjh 100, nungka wanjh bibornang
Arphaxad.
Dja bu Arphaxad danginj Shem djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 500, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Arphaxad mimbini bu mandjewk 35 wanjh nungka bibornang Shelah.
Dja bu Shelah danginj, Arphaxad djahdjalmimbini bu mandjewk 403, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Shelah mimbini bu mandjewk 30, wanjh bibornang Eber.
Dja bu Eber danginj, Shelah djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 403, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Eber mimbini bu mandjewk 34 wanjh bibornang Peleg.
Dja bu Peleg danginj Eber djahdjalmimbini bu mandjewk 430, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Peleg mimbini bu mandjewk thirty nungka bibornang Reu.
Dja bu Reu danginj, Peleg djahdjalmimbini bu mandjewk 209, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Reu mimbini mandjewk 32 wanjh nungka bibornang Serug.
Dja bu Serug danginj, Reu djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 207, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Serug mimbini mandjewk 30, wanjh bibornang Nahor.
Dja bu Nahor danginj, Serug djahdjalmimbini bu mandjewk 200, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Bu Nahor mimbini mandjewk 29 wanjh nungka bibornang Terah.
Dja bu Terah danginj, Nahor djahdjalmimbini mandjewk 119, dja benbalbornabornang birribuyika bebeywurd mak ngalbebeywurd.
Dja Terah bu mimbini mandjewk 70, nungka wanjh benbornang Abram, Nahor, dja Haran.
Bu Abram Danginj.
Kuhni wanjh kabenyolyolme nawu Terah benbornang dja benkebmawahmeng. Terah wanjh kornkumo bedberre nawu Abram, Nahor dja Haran. Haran nunganwali bibornang nawu Lot.

Kaluk Haran doweng kore kunred bolkngeyyoy Ur kore kubolkwarlah bedberre nawu birringeyyoy Chaldea, kumekbe kore Haran danginj. Dja bu doweng wanjh Terah nawu nuyeni kornkumo, nungka wanjh djaldarrkidni.

Abram dja Nahor bindibebbehmey ngalbibininjkobeng. Abram nuyeni ngalbininjkobeng kaluk ngeyyoy Sarai, dja ngalbu Nahor nuyeni ngaleng wanjh ngeyyoy Milcah, ngalbeywurd nuyeni Haran. Nungka Haran wanjh kornkumo berrewoneng Milcah dja Iscah.
Dja Sarai ngaleng ngalwurdyakni dja ngalwalirrngwarreni.

Kaluk Terah benmey beywurd nuye Abram, dja Mawah nuye nawu Lot nawu Haran bibornang, dja mak ngalbininjdoy nuye Sarai, ngalbu Abram nuye ngalbininjkobeng, dja birridolkkang birribolkbawong Ur kunred bedberre bininj nawu birringeyyoy birrikang Chaldea, dja birribalbolkyikani kunred kubolkwarlah Canaan, dja bu birribebmeng kabolkngeyyo Haran, wanjh kumekbe birriyerrkang birrini.
Terah wanjh mandjewk nuyeni 205 bu mimbini, wanjh doweng kore kunred Haran.
